issue_title: [Enhancement] Add hash support for Todo to enable use in sets and dicts

approach.description: Add __hash__ method to Todo dataclass based on id field

risks: Todo is mutable; hash is based on id only. Changing id after adding to a hash-based container will break the container.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: hash(Todo(id=1, text='a')) does not raise TypeError
Two Todo objects with same id have same hash
Todo objects can be added to a set
